title: RTA modpacks
body:
**RTA MODPACKS - Speedrun Optimization Pack (Minecraft 1.16.5)**

## Overview
This modpack is designed for Minecraft speedrunners (RTA/IGT).  
It includes essential tools for practice and optimization, such as Atum, WorldPreview, speedrunIGT, and performance optimization mods sourced from Modrinth.  
All mods are pre-configured to make setup quick and easy.

This modpack is for Minecraft 1.16.5 only.

## Features
- Speedrun-focused setup for practice runs
- In-Game Timer (IGT) support for accurate timing
- World preview functionality
- Auto reset feature via Atum
- Performance optimization mods included

## Recommended Settings
Recommended seed:
8398967436125155523

- Use Atum’s auto reset feature for faster practice.
- Some newer or unrelated seeds may not work properly in 1.16.5

## How to Use
All mods are automatically installed and configured.  
However, you need to set up Atum’s auto reset seed before starting.

Just download this modpack and start Minecraft.

## Notes
- This modpack is intended for practice and optimization purposes.
- It may not be suitable for official leaderboard submissions depending on rules and verification requirements.
